terbaru.judul: Correlations and Flow of Information between The New York Times and Stock Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We use Random Matrix Theory (RMT) and information theory to analyze the correlations and flow of information between 64,939 news from The New York Times and 40 world financial indices during 10 months along the period 2015-2016.

terbaru.judul: Extracting Predictive Information from Heterogeneous Data Streams using Gaussian Processes
terbaru.pelajaran: We show evidence that ARD kernels produce meaningful feature rankings that help retain salient inputs and reduce input dimensionality, providing a framework for sifting through financial complexity.

terbaru.judul: Twitter Sentiment Analysis Applied to Finance: A Case Study in the Retail Industry
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents a financial analysis over Twitter sentiment analytics extracted from listed retail brands.

terbaru.judul: Coupling news sentiment with web browsing data improves prediction of intra-day price dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that the aggregation of web users' behavior can be elicited to overcome this problem in a hard to predict complex system, namely the financial market.

terbaru.judul: Good Debt or Bad Debt: Detecting Semantic Orientations in Economic Texts
terbaru.pelajaran: The use of robo-readers to analyze news texts is an emerging technology trend in computational finance.

terbaru.judul: How news affect the trading behavior of different categories of investors in a financial market
terbaru.pelajaran: We investigate the trading behavior of a large set of single investors trading the highly liquid Nokia stock over the period 2003-2008 with the aim of determining the relative role of endogenous and exogenous factors that may affect their behavior.
